name: 5 Years
summary: A small megawad consists of 3 maps in Limit Removing format. The Hell invades in our reality, so, get ready your shotgun and kill them all.

name: 5yn-OS
summary: Live inside a fictional operating system you can code, customise and break. Learn real programming with the built-in FantasyLang IDE, script the terminal, explore a stylised darknet, and solve a comedy mystery hidden in the desktop itself.
